name: OpenClaw
tagline: An open-source personal AI assistant that runs on your own machine and takes instructions from WhatsApp, Telegram or other chat apps.
about: OpenClaw is an open-source personal agent. It runs on your computer or server, connects to your inbox, calendar and other accounts, and you talk to it through the chat apps you already use.
pros: Open source and free to run.
Runs on your own machine instead of a hosted service.
Works from chat apps such as WhatsApp and Telegram.
cons: You install and maintain it yourself.
An agent with access to your email and calendar needs careful permission settings.
